title: Free Invoice Template
description: Simple invoice template for freelancers, consultants, and small businesses.
intro: This free invoice template helps professionals create clear invoices for clients and completed projects.
whenToUse: Use this invoice template when billing clients for products or services.
template:
Invoice Number: [Invoice Number]
Date: [Date]

Bill To:
[Client Name]

Services:
- [Service Description]: [Amount]

Total Due: [Total]
Due Date: [Due Date]
example:
Invoice Number: INV-1001
Date: March 10, 2026

Bill To:
Acme Design Co

Services:
- Logo Design: $500

Total Due: $500

faqs.question: What should an invoice include?
faqs.answer: Invoices should include payment amounts, due dates, client details, and services provided.

faqs.question: Can freelancers use this template?
faqs.answer: Yes. This invoice template is ideal for freelancers and consultants.

title: Invoice Template for Photographers
description: Free photography invoice template for freelance photographers and creative professionals.
intro: This photography invoice template helps photographers bill clients professionally for photoshoots, editing services, events, and licensing work. It includes sections for services, pricing, payment terms, and client details.
whenToUse: Use this template after completing photography work or when requesting deposits for upcoming projects.
template:
Invoice Number: [Invoice Number]
Date: [Date]

Photographer:
[Your Name or Studio]

Client:
[Client Name]

Services:
- Wedding Photography: [$Amount]
- Editing Services: [$Amount]

Total Due: [$Total]
Payment Due Date: [Date]

Payment Method:
[Payment Details]
example:
Invoice Number: PHOTO-102
Date: March 12, 2026

Photographer:
Bright Lens Studio

Client:
Emily Davis

Services:
- Engagement Photoshoot: $600
- Editing Services: $150

Total Due: $750
tips: Clearly list all photography and editing services.
Include payment deadlines to avoid delays.
Save copies of invoices for tax purposes.

faqs.question: What should a photography invoice include?
faqs.answer: It should include services provided, pricing, payment terms, and client information.

faqs.question: Can photographers request deposits?
faqs.answer: Yes, many photographers request partial upfront payments before shoots.

faqs.question: Should editing fees be separate?
faqs.answer: Separating editing fees can make invoices clearer for clients.

title: Invoice Template for Consultants
description: Free consultant invoice template for billing advisory services, strategy sessions, and project work.
intro: This consultant invoice template helps independent consultants and consulting agencies bill clients professionally for strategy, advisory, and project-based services. It includes sections for services rendered, payment terms, and client information.
whenToUse: Use this template when invoicing clients for consulting services, retainers, project work, or hourly advisory sessions.
template:
Invoice Number: [Invoice Number]
Date: [Date]

Consultant:
[Your Name or Company]

Client:
[Client Name]

Services Provided:
- Strategy Consultation: [$Amount]
- Project Planning: [$Amount]

Total Due: [$Total]
Due Date: [Date]

Payment Instructions:
[Payment Details]
example:
Invoice Number: CONS-104
Date: April 12, 2026

Consultant:
Growth Advisory Group

Client:
BluePeak Solutions

Services Provided:
- Business Strategy Session: $1,500
- Market Research Analysis: $800

Total Due: $2,300
tips: Clearly outline consulting services and deliverables.
Include payment deadlines and accepted payment methods.
Use professional invoice numbering for organization.
Keep records of invoices for accounting and taxes.

faqs.question: What should a consultant invoice include?
faqs.answer: A consultant invoice should include services provided, pricing, payment terms, and client details.

faqs.question: Can consultants charge hourly rates?
faqs.answer: Yes, consultants commonly bill hourly, daily, or per project.

faqs.question: Should payment terms be included?
faqs.answer: Yes, clear payment terms help reduce delays and misunderstandings.

title: Flat-Rate Service Invoice
intro: Use this invoice for fixed-price service work.
whenToUse: Billing clients for project-based, flat-fee services.
example:
Invoice #: 3001
Date: May 10, 2026
Service: Website redesign
Amount: $3,000
Due: June 10, 2026

faqs.question: What payment terms to include?
faqs.answer: Include due date and accepted payment methods.

title: Recurring Services Invoice
description: Invoice template for ongoing subscription or retainer services.
intro: Use for monthly retainers or recurring service charges.
whenToUse: Billing recurring clients on a set schedule.
example:
Invoice #: 4002
Period: May 2026
Service: Social media retainer
Amount: $1,500
Due: June 1, 2026
